# LangFn

> TypeScript SDK for model calls, tools, graphs, retrieval, observability, HTTP, and MCP.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Create a TypeScript client and run a deterministic model call.
- [HTTP routes](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/http.md) — Mount model and trace endpoints with trusted authentication.
- [LangFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — TypeScript SDK for model, tool, graph, retrieval, and evaluation workflows.
- [MCP integration](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/mcp.md) — Expose selected LangFn tools through McpFn.
- [Memory and RAG](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/memory-and-rag.md) — Choose in-process memory or injected retrieval adapters.
- [Models and providers](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/models-and-providers.md) — Select first-party capabilities and preserve provider messages.
- [Observability and evaluation](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/observability-and-evaluation.md) — Capture scoped traces, usage, feedback, and measured outcomes.
- [Operations and limits](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/operations-and-limits.md) — Source availability, release checks, and external proof boundaries.
- [Prompts and structured output](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/prompts-and-structured.md) — Format prompt templates and validate model output.
- [Provider compatibility](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/reference/compatibility.md) — First-party TypeScript provider capability matrix.
- [Reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — TypeScript package exports, provider matrix, and source release contract.
- [Package exports](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/reference/package-exports.md) — Public TypeScript subpaths in the current langfn manifest.
- [Release gate](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/reference/release-gate.md) — TypeScript build, test, package, and live-qualification boundaries.
- [TypeScript package](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/reference/typescript.md) — Current langfn TypeScript package guide.
- [Streaming and tools](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/streaming-and-tools.md) — Handle cancellation, tool policy, and network boundaries.
- [Workflows and agents](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/langfn/docs/content/docs/workflows.md) — Compose chains, parallel work, routers, state graphs, and agents.
